findings.source_quote: But when he saw the wind boisterous, he was afraid; and beginning to sink, he cried, saying, Lord, save me. And immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him, and said unto him, O thou of little faith, wherefore didst thou doubt?

findings.translation_quote: Lakini alipomuona upepo ukitabasamu, akatisha moyo; na akaanza kuzama, akalia, akisema, Bwana, niokoe. Mara Yesu akatembea mkono wake, akamkamata, naye akamwambia, Ee mwenye imani kidogo, kwa nini uliwaza vibaya?...
